The '''BB-2 Shuttle''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] active around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. It was manufactured by the spaceworks arm of [[BullbaBong]], a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] company. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] could be used by law enforcement or paramilitary units. The solid in-system ship was fit for long-distance travel.
